entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I think I need to return something? I bought a jersey, but the website is so confusing, I'm not sure what to do. I feel a bit lost.
Not a problem, I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, I think so... It's VF91-88432. The name is Mark Chen. I just don't understand the process at all.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the VeloFit Signature Jersey, delivered on January 9th. To make sure I get you to the right place, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, um, a preference I guess? It's the wrong size. I ordered my usual size, but this jersey is just way too tight across the chest. I'd like to get an exchange if I can.
I see. A sizing issue. I can definitely look into that. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.
Okay... I saw something on the website about 10 days and I got worried I missed the window. It's all so complicated. Can't you just help me?

Absolutely, I can help. And no need to worry. For apparel items like that jersey, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it just eight days ago, you are well within that timeframe.
Oh, 90 days? Really? That's a huge relief. I completely misunderstood.
It's no trouble at all. I've gone ahead and approved your return. I can process an exchange for the next size up, or I can issue a full refund. Which would you prefer?
The exchange would be great, thank you! I really like the design, it was just too tight.

Excellent. I have initiated the exchange for you. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid return label in just a few moments. Simply send the original jersey back, and we'll ship the new size out as soon as the return is in transit.
That's perfect. Thank you so much for making that so simple, David.
You're very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
